about.title: About Us
about.p1Part1: MEMORIA is an all in one web based invitation platform designed to help people
about.p1Highlight: create, manage, and share meaningful moments effortlessly.
about.p1Part2: We believe that every special occasion deserves more than just an ordinary invitation, it should be interactive, personal, and easy to manage without requiring technical skills or relying on developers. That's why MEMORIA empowers you to take full control of your invitations, from designing and editing content to publishing and managing guests, all within one seamless platform.
about.p2: With MEMORIA, you can create beautiful digital invitations in minutes, customize details anytime, and share them instantly. The platform also enables RSVP tracking and allows guests to send messages and digital gifts, creating a more engaging experience. At MEMORIA, we are not just building a tool, we are creating a smarter, simpler, and more memorable way to celebrate life's most important moments.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before creating your digital invitation.

editAfterPublish.q: Can I edit my invitation after publishing it?
editAfterPublish.a: Yes, you can update your invitation anytime, even after it has been published. All changes will be reflected instantly.

startCreating.q: How do I start creating my invitation?
startCreating.a: Start by selecting a template, customize your event details, then publish and share your invitation link in minutes.

shareWithGuests.q: How do I share my invitation with guests?
shareWithGuests.a: After publishing, you can share your invitation link directly via WhatsApp, Instagram, email, or any platform you like.

trackRsvp.q: Can I track who has seen or responded to my invitation?
trackRsvp.a: Yes. You can monitor RSVP status and guest responses from your dashboard, so you always know who has confirmed or opened the invitation.

suitableEvents.q: Is Memoria suitable for different types of events?
suitableEvents.a: Absolutely. Memoria works great for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and many other occasions—just pick a template that matches your vibe.
